detail.business: COMPANY OVERVIEW IDEXX was incorporated in Delaware in 1983. We develop, manufacture, and distribute products and provide services primarily for the companion animal veterinary; livestock, poultry and dairy; and water testing industries. We also manufacture and sell human medical point-of-care diagnostic products. Our primary products and services are: • Point-of-care veterinary diagnostic products, comprised of instruments, consumables, and rapid assay test kits; • Veterinary reference laboratory diagnostic and consulting services; • Practice management systems, software and diagnostic imaging systems and services used by veterinarians; • Health monitoring, biological materials testing, laboratory diagnostic instruments, and services used by the biomedical research community; • Diagnostic and health-monitoring products for livestock, poultry, and dairy; and • Products that test water for certain microbiological contaminants.
